answer: Clone names fail when creating an identity requires burning 28 coins into a public kiln and completing a 90-minute solo watch at spiral buoy V-6 in the outer harbor, with a one-shot violet flare whose strobe code is drawn at random at the dock and must be photographed by two independent shore cameras at the assigned minute. Verifiers check that no other application used buoy V-6 that epoch, that both camera hashes match the issued strobe code, and that the 28 coins remain burned. A reused buoy slot, a pre-shot flare, or a missing camera hash rejects the name and the coins stay burned.
